title: Happy Ingredients
text: I loved the products in my therabox.  It was my first box, so I wasn't sure what to expect.  However, it felt like I was the one who picked out the products in my box.  I felt as if it was curated personally for me using the products I generally pick up when I'm shopping.  I usually don't do subscriptions but I'm looking forward to this one monthly.
label: positive
